assertions: IUniswapV2Pair(busd_pair).getReserves() returns reserves matching pair balance pre-attack

attack_steps: Flash loan 350K BUSD from PancakeSwap V3.
Swap BUSD -> LAXO via fee-on-transfer router using busd_pair so router holds LAXO.
Add LAXO/BNB liquidity to wbnb_pair, then remove tiny LP via FOT remove to launder LAXO into attacker's wallet.
Call laxo.transfer(busd_pair, laxo.balanceOf(busd_pair)). Recipient==pair triggers SELL path in LAXOToken._transfer.

In SELL path, sellFee (5%) is taken from sender (attacker), and actualBurn (~95% of amount) is super._transfer'd FROM busd_pair to DEAD (burn-from-wrong-account bug). pair.sync() then drops pair LAXO reserves to the post-burn balance. Finally super._transfer sends burnAmount from attacker to busd_pair, leaving pair LAXO BALANCE > reserves by the surplus.
Compute amountOut = router.getAmountOut(surplus, reserve_LAXO_post_sync, reserve_BUSD) and call busd_pair.swap(amountOut, 0, attacker, '') directly to extract BUSD using the unsynced surplus.
Repay flash loan and pocket ~137K BUSD profit.
preconditions: buyEnabled == true and attacker has buyQuota for the initial BUSD->LAXO buy (or path uses excluded-from-fee actor for the buy step).
balanceOf[DEAD] < MAX_SELL_BURN so the actualBurn branch executes (otherwise the desync does not occur).
attacker holds enough LAXO to make laxo.transfer(busd_pair, pair_balance) succeed.
